Bemis Assurance® with Clean·Shield

Product Description

The raised seat lifts the user 3" so sitting and standing take less effort. A shield under the ring keeps everything in the bowl and wipes clean, unlike most raised seats and risers. The wide ring spreads pressure and carries up to 1000 lbs. The Stay·Tite fastening system keeps it secure.
  • Raised 3 inches for easier sitting and standing
  • Shield under the ring keeps waste in the bowl
  • 1000 lb weight capacity
  • Stay·Tite fastening never loosens
  • Super-grip bumpers resist sliding
